question: Which site-level inscription inventories, excavation histories and metadata can be sourced for Gujarat, Kutch and Maharashtra, retaining the requested Nuhato cross-reference?
outcome: 25 sites;130 actual queries; at least3 site-specific queries/site;496 local faces/460 families;317 CISI1 catalogue object slots across10 sites;175 Mahadevan1977 selected objects across5 sites;12 completed reports identified,6 relevant passages read. Two direct catalogue baselines with later finds plus Nuhato with report-cited baseline;13 ICIT-based published sign aggregates,1446 signs, excluded from object totals.
challenge: First pass had unsupported values and search descriptions; full final inventories and Rojdi CISI3.2 pages unavailable; count units and selection rules differ; some downloads failed or returned challenge pages.
remedy: Archive ten originals with hashes; preserve actual searches/access failures; inspect primary passages and catalogue plates; retain count disagreements and site-specific unresolved fields; UTF-8 current files.
retry_when: Full Rojdi CISI3.2, Nuhato CISI2 p.390 or unread final object inventories become available, or the local export gains registration/source crosswalks.
